title: My trip: what happened?
objective: Raconter une expérience passée de manière intelligible

steps.title: Warm-up: last holidays
steps.student_instruction: Tell a partner three things you did last holidays (I went..., I saw...).
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire émerger des verbes au prétérit ; les classer en réguliers / irréguliers au tableau.

steps.title: Listening: Tour of London
steps.student_instruction: Listen to the bus tour. Note three places and what went wrong.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Après correction, faire raconter la visite au passé : what happened?

steps.title: Language focus: past simple
steps.student_instruction: Make the past: regular -ed and irregular verbs. Ask Did you...? questions.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Formes affirmative, négative (didn't + base verbale), interrogative ; prononciation de -ed.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : verbes à conjuguer dans un récit ; B : récit à partir d'images ; C : récit avec problème, solution et sentiment.

steps.title: Storytelling in pairs
steps.student_instruction: Tell your partner about a real or imaginary trip (6-8 sentences). Your partner asks two Did you...? questions.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Observer la chronologie (first, then, in the end) et l'intelligibilité ; faire changer de binôme une fois.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write two sentences about your trip: one positive, one negative.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; repérer les erreurs récurrentes sur didn't + verbe.

sheets.student_content: Put the verbs in the past: Last summer I ___ (go) to London. We ___ (visit) the Tower. It ___ (rain) and we ___ (not have) umbrellas. We ___ (have) a hot chocolate.
sheets.facilitator_correction: went ; visited ; rained ; didn't have ; had.

sheets.student_content: Look at the four pictures (bus, rain, café, photo) and tell the story of the day in six sentences with first, then, after that, in the end.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : First, we took a bus tour. Then it started to rain. After that, we ran into a café. In the end, we took funny photos.

sheets.student_content: Write a story of 10 sentences about a trip where something went wrong. Include a problem, a solution, your feelings and one Did you...? question for the reader.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : prétérit maîtrisé (réguliers et irréguliers), chronologie, sentiments exprimés.

criteria: L'élève emploie le prétérit de façon compréhensible
L'élève organise son récit dans le temps
L'élève pose une question au passé

common_errors: didn't went au lieu de didn't go
